summary: In this part 56 of Zadul-Ma'ad, Sheikh Ali Mashhour discusses the factors that open a person's heart to Islam and increase faith, emphasizing that while some causes come from Allah and some from one's actions, ultimately guidance is from Allah. He explains that beneficial knowledge—understanding the Quran and Sunnah deeply through contemplation and meditation—is crucial for strengthening faith, more so than searching for scientific miracles in the Quran. The sheikh highlights how studying the internal coherence and interconnectedness of the Quran over years creates unshakeable faith. He then addresses how Muslims have become disconnected from the Quran despite unprecedented physical access to it, attributing this to fear of the Quran's demands for personal change and to distraction by modern entertainment and social media.
